message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager for Arc-enabled clusters

Body.Content:
Managing Kubernetes clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud environments can be complex and fragmented. To simplify this, Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager now supports Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes, enabling organizations to seamlessly manage any CNCF-compliant Kubernetes distribution, regardless of where it’s running.


By Arc-enabling clusters and joining them as Fleet Manager member clusters, users gain centralized visibility into cluster health. Fleet Manager also empowers cluster administrators and application teams with intelligent workload placement, making it easier to deploy configurations and applications consistently across environments. 

This enhancement helps reduce operational overhead, improves deployment agility, and ensures consistent governance across distributed Kubernetes infrastructure.
Learn more.
